features' non-test source files; the bound command exits non-zero when a mutant survives. Exit 0 pass, unconfigured

install.description:
Ownership contract: the kit only ever refreshes or deletes kit artifacts — the paths installed-versions.json
records (managed_files, kit_files). A file the kit cannot prove it wrote is never overwritten or removed: existing
kit-path files without a recorded hash are SKIPped, unproven retired paths are kept with a warning, and
skill/steering/rule collisions halt (rehome with --rehome-*). Project artifacts — bindings, PROGRESS, slice state,
specs, mcp.json — are seeded once and never touched again. Kit files refresh on version change; one the project
changed since the kit wrote it is skipped (--force restores it). An older kit than the one installed is refused
(--force downgrades). Bindings are kept unless --force-bindings. Undo with: asdd uninstall <dir>.
